name: David McKenzie
bio:
David grew up in Melbourne, practically breathing motorsport. His father was a mechanic for a local touring car team, and David spent his weekends at the track, absorbing everything. While he didn't have the mechanical aptitude, he excelled at understanding people. He initially worked in general HR roles, but always kept his eye on the prize: bringing his skills to the motorsport world. He landed a role at Manthey EMA five years ago and quickly rose through the ranks.

As HR Manager, David prioritizes fostering a positive and productive team environment. He believes that a happy team is a winning team, and he's known for his ability to mediate conflicts and build strong relationships between team members. He is passionate about fair treatment and looks to implement procedures that empower employees and create an open communication culture.

David's distinctive trait is his deep understanding of both the technical and human elements of motorsport. This allows him to find the perfect fit for each role, understanding the specific needs and personalities required for success in the high-pressure environment. He is driven by a desire to see every team member reach their full potential.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed with a slight side part
physical.description: David is of average height, with a slightly athletic build and a friendly, approachable face.

quirks: Always has a packet of Tim Tams in his desk drawer, offering them to anyone who visits.
Knows everyone's birthday and makes sure they get a card and a small gift.
Starts every meeting with a quick, often motorsport-related, icebreaker question.
